ideas.title: Uncovering the Minnesota Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the ongoing federal investigation into potential fraud in Minnesota, including the involvement of the DOJ and DHS.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and track the investigation
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
Who is involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme, and following the investigation could lead to significant revelations.
